stewart_read: Customer discloses detailed competitive intelligence — a company that obscured a rebate's true tax treatment. The rep acknowledges warmly ("Honesty is definitely one of the things you should look for") but never asks which company it was or probes further, so this intel dies at the setter stage instead of reaching the closer as usable differentiation.

coaching_implication: Coach the rep to ask one follow-up ("which company was that?") when a customer discloses a prior near-miss — it costs seconds and arms the closer with a concrete differentiation angle (Ion's transparency vs. the prior company's rebate framing).

coaching_implication: This should be flagged loudly for the closer, not just mentioned in passing — an EV owner asking about battery storage unprompted is exactly the kind of anchor the appointment should be built around.

coaching_implication: Even when booking feels secure, close with the explicit fairness check before relaxing into small talk — it's a two-second habit that protects show-rate per the schema's coaching note on button_up.is_that_fair_handshake.
